metadata.name: Knowledge
metadata.summary: Let an agentic worker list, search, read, create, update and remove documents in its own knowledge bases
metadata.description: Design extension exposing seven agentic-worker tools: knowledge_list_bases, knowledge_search, knowledge_list_documents, knowledge_read, knowledge_create, knowledge_update and knowledge_remove. They call the host knowledge port (greentic:extension-host/knowledge@0.1.0): the designer decides the tenant, the team and which bases the worker may touch (the bases bound to the worker); a tool only names a base by its name. Text documents only (plain text, markdown, CSV, JSON). Remove drops a document from the base and keeps the library copy. Requires a designer that provides the knowledge port; v1 serves it in Test chat only.

tools.name: knowledge_list_bases
tools.description: List the knowledge bases you may use (name, description, number of documents). Only the bases bound to you appear; use one of these names in every other knowledge tool.

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.description: Search one of your knowledge bases and return the most relevant passages (at most 20). Use this to answer a question from your documents when you do not know which document holds the answer.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","required":["knowledge_base","query"],"properties":{"knowledge_base":{"type":"string","description":"Exact name of one of this worker's knowledge bases (from knowledge_list_bases)"},"query":{"type":"string","description":"What to look for, in natural language or keywords"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":20,"description":"How many passages to return (default 5, at most 20)"}}}
tools.output_schema: {"type":"object","required":["ok"],"properties":{"ok":{"type":"boolean"},"hits":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"document_id":{"type":"string"},"name":{"type":"string"},"passage":{"type":"string","description":"An excerpt of the matching text, shortened by the host"},"score":{"type":"number"}}}},"error":{"type":"object","properties":{"code":{"type":"string"},"message":{"type":"string"}}}}}

tools.name: knowledge_list_documents
tools.description: List the documents of one of your knowledge bases (id, name, size), to find a document or get its id.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","required":["knowledge_base"],"properties":{"knowledge_base":{"type":"string","description":"Exact name of one of this worker's knowledge bases (from knowledge_list_bases)"}}}

tools.name: knowledge_read
tools.description: Read the full text of one document in one of your knowledge bases, by its id.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","required":["knowledge_base","document_id"],"properties":{"knowledge_base":{"type":"string","description":"Exact name of one of this worker's knowledge bases"},"document_id":{"type":"string","description":"Id from knowledge_list_documents, knowledge_search, knowledge_create or knowledge_update"}}}
tools.output_schema: {"type":"object","required":["ok"],"properties":{"ok":{"type":"boolean"},"name":{"type":"string"},"text":{"type":"string"},"truncated":{"type":"boolean","description":"true when only the start of the text was returned"},"error":{"type":"object","properties":{"code":{"type":"string"},"message":{"type":"string"}}}}}

tools.name: knowledge_create
tools.description: Save new text (plain text, markdown, CSV or JSON) as a document in one of your knowledge bases. To change an existing document, use knowledge_update.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","required":["knowledge_base","name","text"],"properties":{"knowledge_base":{"type":"string","description":"Exact name of one of this worker's knowledge bases"},"name":{"type":"string","description":"Display name of the new document"},"text":{"type":"string","description":"Document text: plain text, markdown, CSV or JSON"}}}
tools.output_schema: {"type":"object","required":["ok"],"properties":{"ok":{"type":"boolean"},"document_id":{"type":"string"},"created":{"type":"boolean","description":"false when an identical document already existed and was reused"},"error":{"type":"object","properties":{"code":{"type":"string"},"message":{"type":"string"}}}}}

tools.name: knowledge_update
tools.description: Replace the whole text of a document in one of your knowledge bases. Returns the document's id afterwards, which may differ from the old one.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","required":["knowledge_base","document_id","text"],"properties":{"knowledge_base":{"type":"string","description":"Exact name of one of this worker's knowledge bases"},"document_id":{"type":"string","description":"Id of the document to replace"},"text":{"type":"string","description":"The complete new text (it replaces the old text, it is not appended)"}}}
tools.output_schema: {"type":"object","required":["ok"],"properties":{"ok":{"type":"boolean"},"document_id":{"type":"string","description":"The document's id after the update; use this one from now on, it may differ from the old id"},"error":{"type":"object","properties":{"code":{"type":"string"},"message":{"type":"string"}}}}}

tools.name: knowledge_remove
tools.description: Remove a document from one of your knowledge bases. The library copy is kept; only its membership in the base is removed.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","required":["knowledge_base","document_id"],"properties":{"knowledge_base":{"type":"string","description":"Exact name of one of this worker's knowledge bases"},"document_id":{"type":"string","description":"Id from knowledge_list_documents, knowledge_search, knowledge_create or knowledge_update"}}}
tools.output_schema: {"type":"object","required":["ok"],"properties":{"ok":{"type":"boolean"},"removed":{"type":"boolean","description":"false when the document was not in that base"},"error":{"type":"object","properties":{"code":{"type":"string"},"message":{"type":"string"}}}}}
